name: paved
description: Paved engineering commands for AI coding agents: repository context, governed workflows, explicit Tools, verification and evidence, executed by a pinned project-local Paved runtime.

interface.longDescription: Paved gives coding agents repository context and a governed workflow for changes. Start with intent, review and approve a plan, then execute with tests, verification and evidence. The plugin activates a version-pinned runtime in the repository. Use the local Workbench to follow runs and recent Claude Code or Codex activity.
defaultPrompt: Show the Paved status of this repository
Follow Paved work in the local dashboard
